agentId.description: An agent whose pull request to read, by its id as list_agents answered it; leave it out to name a repository's pull request instead.

repository.description: The repository whose pull request to read, as owner/name, with number; leave it out with agentId.

number.description: The pull request's number: with repository, the one to read; with agentId, another pull request of the agent's repository, left out for the agent's own.

workspace.description: With repository, the workspace whose GitHub installation reaches it, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.
